behaviours.secrets: Never publish a secret: no vault key, write key or private credential, and nothing on the redaction or private lists.
behaviours.sources: Every claim can be traced to its source, and what we republish or vendor stays exactly as it was.
behaviours.reach: Every page can be found, reached, read and shared, by a person and by an agent.
behaviours.voice: Write in the house voice: no em-dash, no retired words, no superlatives about ourselves.
behaviours.release: Every release has one new version, is what is live, and can be rebuilt from the repository.
behaviours.tools: The reader's tools do what the page says they do, on every screen and in every theme.
behaviours.data: The reader's data stays theirs: encrypted in the browser, carried between their devices, unreadable by any server.
behaviours.mandate: The agents stay within their mandate: they push only here, contact nobody, and report how they are doing.

runs.ci-report: CI, reports but does not block the deploy

keep.boundary: kept by something outside the agent's grant
keep.setting: kept by a system the agent's own grant can change
keep.expectation: kept only because the agent runs it

checks.what: version.txt matches every page badge, the versions table, llms.txt and index.md
checks.why: a reader and an agent must be able to say which release they are reading

checks.what: every relative href and src resolves to a file
checks.why: a broken link is a dead end for a reader and fatal for an agent

checks.what: every figure an article names is in the tree
checks.why: an article that points at a missing figure loses its evidence

checks.what: every script loaded at runtime is present
checks.why: a page whose behaviour fails to load looks fine and does nothing

checks.what: a payment link on a page is the live link, not a test one
checks.why: a reader who pays must reach a real payment

checks.what: every canonical and og:url names this host, or the stated source
checks.why: search engines and agents must credit the right place

checks.what: every hub is in llms.txt; the sitemap and the tree agree both ways
checks.why: agents are a first-class audience: what is not listed does not exist for them

checks.what: nothing in the tree looks like a vault key
checks.why: a published key opens a vault to anyone, for ever

checks.what: every page carries this release's nav, footer and stamp
checks.why: a page left on an old chrome tells the reader the wrong version

checks.what: every page opens and closes the same number of divs
checks.why: an unbalanced page renders differently in every browser

checks.check: Every page ends with an agent block
checks.what: each page closes with the block that tells an agent what it is
checks.why: the house rule inherited from issues-fs.sgit.ai

checks.what: republished material states a first-published date and a source link
checks.why: the site's own argument, that evidence must be linked, applied to itself

checks.what: nothing Tier 3 from the source manifest appears anywhere
checks.why: some briefing material must never be published

checks.what: every generator of a committed page is in the repository
checks.why: a page nobody can rebuild; it happened twice from one cause

checks.what: every imported file still hashes to its record
checks.why: edit moved content on the new side and the two drift

checks.what: numbers unique, never reused, never moved
checks.why: a link written today must open the same list in a year

checks.what: the vendored library hashes to VENDOR.md
checks.why: one code base, pinned, refreshed only from upstream

checks.what: every page is linked from another page
checks.why: unreachable is the same as unpublished

checks.what: every page has a .md twin whose links resolve
checks.why: a dangling .md link is fatal to an agent

checks.what: no body left hidden for clients without the script
checks.why: hidden text hurt the site's ranking once

checks.what: every og:image exists and is a format previews show
checks.why: a shared link otherwise renders as a bare title

checks.what: the shared scripts parse
checks.why: one syntax error stops every page's behaviour

checks.what: retired product names, old stage words, hype
checks.why: retired concepts and legacy naming confuse readers

checks.what: no vault-key shape and no write-credential prefix
checks.why: a pasted key arrives self-labelled; catch it

checks.what: no live vault passphrase, derived safely from local secrets
checks.why: the one leak a pattern cannot see

checks.what: the em-dash, in prose only
checks.why: many readers now find it off-putting; removed in v0.3.0

checks.what: one word, in article prose
checks.why: removed at the author's request in v0.6.62

checks.check: Version, subject and next minor agree
checks.what: the bump is the next minor and named in the commit subject
checks.why: a version is never reused or skipped

checks.what: a pull request into main carries a .0 major
checks.why: majors are deliberate

checks.check: The meter charges for what was read
checks.what: a tenth of 5p for an older article; no charge twice; a hidden tab adds nothing
checks.why: pay after you read: the charge must match the reading

checks.check: Search and ask find the current text
checks.what: the index is this release's; answers cite numbered passages
checks.why: an answer must be checkable where it came from

checks.check: Themes stay readable, colour is a token
checks.what: five themes, contrast, no literal colour, the bar on one row
checks.why: a theme that hides text breaks the page for that reader

checks.check: The front page works without JavaScript
checks.what: three views, nothing missing without scripts, the builder idempotent
checks.why: the front page is the first thing every reader sees

checks.what: a list is carried in its link, invalid entries dropped and named
checks.why: a list must open the same for whoever gets the link

checks.what: each finding behaves as recorded
checks.why: a known behaviour does not change by accident

checks.check: The wire reads its real vaults
checks.what: each wire names its vault and commit; nothing from a vault becomes a script
checks.why: a wire must show where its news came from, and stay inert

checks.what: every issue links this site absolutely, with one LinkedIn box
checks.why: the foot travels with the text when it is pasted

checks.what: reads carried between devices; the server sees ciphertext only
checks.why: the reader's account is theirs, on every device

checks.what: the link carries only where to write and the public key
checks.why: any browser can write; none can read

checks.what: notes kept as you read, sent down a lane
checks.why: the reader decides what reaches the newsroom

checks.what: PRF opens the vault; no key in browser storage; the library is pinned
checks.why: a passkey is the door, and nothing else is

checks.what: every section's summary was written after its last change
checks.why: a summary of an old version misleads the reader

checks.what: the article is 390 pixels wide
checks.why: a page wider than the phone scrolls sideways

checks.what: every quote in a graph is in the article word for word
checks.why: a graph quote is evidence; it must be exact

checks.what: linked articles exist; relations and topics are in the lists
checks.why: the build rejects anything else; catch it first

checks.check: The version is free; nobody pushed meanwhile
checks.what: no release note, row or tag for the version; origin equals HEAD
checks.why: two agents once took the same version

checks.what: the new version is served and its tag exists
checks.why: a release is done when it is live

checks.check: Image names free in both repositories
checks.what: an image name sgit.ai already uses stops the build
checks.why: two images would fight for one path

checks.what: no local key, write key or vault path in the staged diff
checks.why: the last check before anything leaves the machine

checks.what: no name from the private list is added
checks.why: people who did not agree to be named

checks.what: no em-dash added; no superlative self-claim
checks.why: the voice rules, checked on every commit

checks.what: the report block ends the answer when due
checks.why: if it stops appearing, part of the policy has fallen out

checks.what: the full policy is read back after every summary
checks.why: a summary can drop a rule

checks.what: no uncommitted work left behind
checks.why: the container is temporary

checks.what: sgit.ai's push URL disabled; GitHub access scoped to this repository
checks.why: the source site is read-only for this session

checks.check: Contact nobody; no PR or issue unasked
checks.what: nothing is sent to a person or opened on GitHub
checks.why: outward actions need the owner

checks.what: every fact, number and name checked at its source
checks.why: an unverified count is a guess in print
